info.title: Lago API (curated)
info.description: The three Lago operations realm-lago's producers use. Every filter described here was called against Lago v1.53 and its effect counted; a parameter Lago accepts and ignores is not listed as though it narrowed.

LagoApiKey.description: An organization API key (Developers -> API keys). Reads see the whole organization.

parameters.name: search_term
parameters.description: SUBSTRING match over name, external id and email (verified: `bluth.com` finds Bluth Company by its billing email). It is a search, not a key: `stark.com` would also return `notstark.com`. A caller that needs the exact customer must check what came back.

200.description: customers is the page; meta.total_count the total

parameters.name: external_customer_id
parameters.description: EXACT: only this customer's invoices, by the id the business gave the customer (verified: 4 of 49).

parameters.name: payment_status
parameters.description: pending, succeeded or failed. Narrows at the source (verified: failed 1 of 49).

parameters.name: payment_overdue
parameters.description: true for invoices past their due date and unpaid.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: draft, finalized, voided, failed or pending. A draft is not yet a bill.

200.description: invoices is the page; each carries its customer inline. Amounts are integer CENTS.
subscriptions is the page. plan_amount_cents is integer CENTS per billing period; the period's length is on the plan, which this listing does not inline.

get.description: Lago lists ACTIVE subscriptions only unless asked for others with `status[]=...`, Rails' array syntax. That parameter is deliberately NOT declared here: the host's HTTP client refuses a query parameter whose NAME contains `[` ("Invalid character '[' for QUERY_PARAM"), and a declared parameter that cannot be sent fails the whole call. So this realm sees active subscriptions and says so.

post.summary: Subscribe a customer to a plan
post.description: Starts billing a customer on a plan. `external_id` is the subscription's own id in the business's terms; sending the same one again returns the existing subscription and creates nothing, so a retried call cannot double-bill. A plan billed in advance is invoiced as soon as the subscription starts.

x-embabel-effect.writes: a subscription, and the invoices it generates from then on
x-embabel-effect.reversible: partly: it can be terminated, but invoices it has already generated stay
x-embabel-effect.sensitive: it bills the customer from then on

external_customer_id.description: The customer, by the id the business gave it.

external_id.description: The subscription's own id; repeating it returns the existing subscription.

name.description: What the subscription is called on invoices.

subscription_at.description: When it starts, ISO 8601; now if omitted.

post.summary: Void an invoice: write off what is owed on it
post.description: Marks a finalized, unpaid invoice void: nothing more is expected on it. Final: a voided invoice cannot be un-voided, and voiding it again is refused (`not_voidable`).

x-embabel-effect.reversible: no: a void is final; the amount would have to be invoiced again
x-embabel-effect.sensitive: it cancels money the customer owes

parameters.name: lago_id
parameters.description: Lago's own id for the invoice.
